title: KestrelCare Cancellation Terms and Refund Bases
content:
## 1. Right to cancel

The holder may cancel a pending or active KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan at any time.

## 2. The confirmed request

A cancellation is processed only after the holder has confirmed a cancellation request for this plan with a dated odometer statement, except the flat cancellation that follows a completed 7-day return of the vehicle, which needs no request. The confirmation is read from the cancellation request recorded for this plan (its status confirmed, with the odometer at the request), not from a statement made in conversation.

The clause "The request date is the cancellation effective date;" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for cancellation settlements.

A request not confirmed within the cancellation confirmation days lapses.

## 3. Refund basis

The refund basis is decided in this order:

1. When the reason is one of the plan's flat cancel reasons (the vehicle returned under the 7-day return), the plan is cancelled from inception: full refund, no fee.
2. Otherwise, when the request date is within the free-look days counted from the sale date (sale date as day 0, last day included) and no claim has been paid, the refund is the full price with no fee.
3. The clause "Otherwise the refund is pro rata: the used share is the greater of the days used over the term days and the miles used over the term miles; the refund is the price times one minus the used share, less the cancellation fee, less net claims paid when the plan deducts claims, rounded to the cent and never below zero." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for cancellation settlements.

*Free-look boundary (hypothetical plan sold on 1 April, 60-day free look):* day 60 is 31 May. A request dated 31 May with no claim paid qualifies for the full price; a request dated 1 June does not.

## 4. One refund, payee and timing

- Each plan has one cancellation refund; a plan whose history already carries a cancellation refund does not receive another.
- When the plan was financed and its finance contract is active, the refund is paid to Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder and credited to principal; otherwise it is paid to the holder.
- Refunds are issued within the cancellation refund business days.
- The clause "A cancellation refund is issued only on a plan whose status is cancelled." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for cancellation settlements.

superseded_clauses: The request date is the cancellation effective date;

Otherwise the refund is pro rata: the used share is the greater of the days used over the term days and the miles used over the term miles; the refund is the price times one minus the used share, less the cancellation fee, less net claims paid when the plan deducts claims, rounded to the cent and never below zero.
A cancellation refund is issued only on a plan whose status is cancelled.
